exposure: Induction of labor with a balloon catheter
Induction of labor with prostaglandin E2 gel (PGE2)
cohort: Women requiring induction of labor (IOL) at term with a modified Bishop's score (MBS) <7
finding: Induction of labor using a balloon catheter, compared to PGE2 gel, resulted in more unassisted vaginal births, less blood loss, decreased fetal acidaemia, and a greater likelihood of vaginal delivery within 24 hours.
mod_finding: Women induced using a balloon catheter were more likely to have an unassisted vaginal birth compared to those receiving PGE2 gel.
